title: Servertools EN
description: A fork of the Servertools Datapack with english translation and added features
body:
### This datapack is a fork of the [Servertools Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/servertools-datapack) by [Annhilati](https://modrinth.com/user/Annhilati). Go check them out! This datapack provides some simple features that make server moderation easier
📦 Features

Ranks

Ranks with custom prefix and automatic adding of players without rank to the default team and correct sorting in the tab (can be activated and deactivated, no saving):

  • Owner
  • Admin
  • Moderator
  • Guest
  • VIP
  • Streamer
  • Member (Systematic default rank, no prefix)
  • CAM (Forced in spectator mode)

/function st:create/ranks, /function st:remove/ranks

Broadcast Messages:

  • Call to sleep
  • Restart
  • Stop

/function st:broadcast/

Scoreboards

Scoreboard can be activated and deactivated, no saving:

  • Deathcount
  • Health
  • Level

/function st:create/scoreboards, /function st:remove/scoreboards

Announcement of Enderdragons Death

Informs everyone about the death of the Ender Dragon and names the player who made the last hit

Information Bar

Information bar at the top of the screen (still needs to be customized manually)

/function st:create/infobar, /bossbar set servertools:infobar name

Anti-TNT

Can be activated and deactivated. Ignited TNT is destroyed and drops a TNT item.

/function st:set/antitnt

Game Launch Box

Creates a barrier box and sets the worldspawn there. Players can't die.

/function st:create/spawn_box

⚙️ Compatibility
  • Make sure to use the right and in Modrinth stated Minecraft version
  • function-permission-level has to be set to 4 in server.properties so that the server stops when using st:broadcast/stop or st:broadcast/restart
⚠️ Known issues
  • For many server software and host environments the server has to be restarted manually after using st:broadcast/stop or st:broadcast/restart
